description: Monitors the Agent Framework services listed in the finopsPrices variable, not every client in the shared Application Insights resource. Token rates are read live from the hub price sheet using the Cluster URI and Database variables, and cover input, cache reads, cache writes, and output, with the context tier selected per model call. These are token estimates, not invoice totals, and they exclude tool and hosting charges.

panels.description: Operation count and response time use agent invocations. Token totals, costs, and pricing coverage use the same attributed chat calls for the selected agents. Agent token roll-ups are not counted again. Coverage is the percentage of calls with complete counters and applicable Toolkit rates. Known costs remain visible when other calls are unpriced. The shared finopsPrices configuration and finopsUsage query keep the financial views consistent.
panels.title: Summary Statistics
Agent identity
panels.description: Identity from the selected telemetry. Project resource ID and agent ID define the agent; version is a separate dimension. Missing identity is shown explicitly. Full IDs are available to the right without crowding the operational panels.

panels.title: Current project and Foundry tags
panels.description: Live Azure Resource Graph metadata for the selected projects and their parent Foundry accounts in the selected subscription. Tags are current, not historical request-time labels. Project and account tags remain separate; no inheritance is assumed. The Project tag is a business label, not the Foundry project name. Resources outside the subscription or without read access are not returned.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts', 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/projects')
| extend selectedProjects = dynamic([${projectIds:doublequote}])
| mv-expand selectedProject = selectedProjects
| extend parentId = extract(@'(?i)^(.+)/projects/[^/]+$', 1, tostring(selectedProject))
| where id =~ tostring(selectedProject) or id =~ parentId
| summarize take_any(name, type, location, tags) by id
| project Scope = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/projects', 'Project', 'Foundry'), Resource = name, Region = location, ['Project tag'] = tostring(tags.Project), Environment = tostring(tags.env), Organization = tostring(tags.org), Tags = tostring(tags), ['Resource ID'] = id
| order by Scope desc, Resource asc

panels.description: Input and output tokens from attributed chat calls for the selected agents, with priced token cost on the right-hand USD axis. This is the same call population used by the summary and pricing tables. Costs exclude unpriced calls; token totals retain reported usage.
panels.title: Token usage and cost over time

panels.description: Share of reported input and output tokens from attributed chat calls for the selected agents. Uses the same token population as the summary and cost trend. See the agent table for monetary costs and unit rates.
panels.title: Token Usage by Agent

panels.description: Daily token cost estimates for the selected agents, using rates read live from the hub price sheet. Prices are contracted USD per million tokens for the stated account, region, deployment type, and month. Each chat call uses its own model and context tier; input above 272,000 tokens uses long-context rates. Ordinary input = input - cache reads - cache writes. Cache writes use cache_write.input_tokens or the observed Agent Framework cache_creation.input_tokens field. Missing counters are not assumed to be zero. Only priced calls contribute; see pricing coverage in the summary and agent table.
panels.title: Daily token cost estimate

panels.description: Contracted Toolkit rates and observed token costs by provider, model, and per-call context tier for the selected agents. All rates are USD per million tokens. Blended cost uses only priced calls and their input plus output tokens. Rates are read live from the hub price sheet for the current effective period. Pricing coverage includes unpriced calls. Unknown rates remain empty rather than using a default model price.
panels.title: Model rates and token costs

panels.description: Cache-read tokens divided by input tokens for the selected agents' attributed chat calls with valid cache-read counters. The cache economics panel shows the actual Toolkit-priced read cost, write cost, and net benefit rather than assuming a fixed savings percentage.
panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (chat)

panels.description: Reported cache-read and cache-write tokens for the selected agents. Cache cost sums priced reads and writes. Net cache benefit compares those same priced calls with ordinary input pricing at the same model/context tier: reads * (input rate - read rate) - writes * (write rate - input rate). Negative benefits remain negative. This is not an invoice credit; unpriced calls contribute no monetary estimate.
panels.title: Cache economics

panels.description: Distribution of LLM chat finish reasons. Common values: tool_calls (multi-step agent step), stop (completion), length (hit max_tokens), content_filter (safety).
panels.title: Chat Finish Reasons

panels.description: p95 latency of LLM chat calls broken out by gen_ai.response.model. Surfaces silent model routing and per-model latency drift.

panels.description: Agent runs with the token usage and cost breakdown of their directly attributed chat calls. Input, cache-read, cache-write, and output costs sum to the priced token cost. The join uses the invocation span ID, not just the trace ID, so separate runs in one trace do not receive each other's costs. Empty run costs mean no priced direct calls were attributed. Click a row to open its original trace while retaining the dashboard filters.

list.label: Toolkit model-call pricing
list.description: Shared attribution and pricing for the explicit Agent Framework service allowlist. Identity is the project ARM ID plus agent ID, never the display name. Missing identity is isolated by span rather than merged by name. Parent metadata is inherited only when supplied child identity does not conflict. Rates apply only to the verified project. No nested Grafana variables.
list.query:
let uniqueSpans = materialize(spans
| where array_length(pricing.services) == 0 or cloud_RoleName in~ (pricing.services)
| where name has 'invoke_agent' or tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) in ('chat', 'execute_tool')
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, duration, success, operation_ParentId, customDimensions) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id
| extend projectId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.foundry.project.id']), agentId = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.id']), agentDisplayName = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']), agentVersion = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.version']));
let parents = uniqueSpans | where name has 'invoke_agent'
| summarize take_any(parentProject = projectId, parentAgentId = agentId, parentName = agentDisplayName, parentVersion = agentVersion) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, parentId = id;
let attributedSpans = materialize(uniqueSpans
| extend parentId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter parents on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, parentId
| extend parentMatches = isnotempty(parentProject) and isnotempty(parentAgentId) and (isempty(projectId) or projectId =~ parentProject) and (isempty(agentId) or agentId =~ parentAgentId)
| extend projectId = coalesce(projectId, iff(parentMatches, parentProject, '')), agentId = coalesce(agentId, iff(parentMatches, parentAgentId, '')),
    agentDisplayName = coalesce(agentDisplayName, iff(parentMatches, parentName, ''), '(unnamed agent)'), agentVersion = coalesce(agentVersion, iff(parentMatches, parentVersion, ''))
| extend foundryName = extract(@'(?i)/accounts/([^/]+)/projects/', 1, projectId), projectName = extract(@'(?i)/projects/([^/]+)$', 1, projectId)
| extend identityComplete = isnotempty(foundryName) and isnotempty(projectName) and isnotempty(agentId)
| extend agentKey = iff(identityComplete, hash_sha256(strcat(tolower(projectId), '|', agentId)), hash_sha256(strcat('missing|', cloud_RoleName, '|', operation_Id, '|', id))),
    agentRunId = iff(parentMatches, parentId, ''), sessionId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.session.id']), tenantId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.tenant.id']));
let labelCounts = attributedSpans | summarize by agentKey, agentDisplayName | summarize identities = count() by agentDisplayName;
let namedSpans = attributedSpans
| lookup kind=leftouter labelCounts on agentDisplayName
| extend agentLabel = case(not(identityComplete), strcat(agentDisplayName, ' [identity missing; ', id, ']'), identities == 1, agentDisplayName, strcat(agentDisplayName, ' / ', projectName, ' [', substring(agentKey, 0, 8), ']'));
let agentRuns = namedSpans | where name has 'invoke_agent';
let agentTools = namedSpans | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'execute_tool';
let agentUsage = materialize(namedSpans
| where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend model = replace_regex(coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model']), tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])), @'-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$', ''),
    provider = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.provider.name']),
    input = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
    cached = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_tokens'])),
    written = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens'])),
    output = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])
| extend contextTier = case(isnull(input), 'unknown', input > tolong(pricing.longContextTokens), 'long', 'short'),
    cacheValid = coalesce(input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input, false),
    usageValid = coalesce(input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and written >= 0 and cached + written <= input and output >= 0, false)
| extend p = price[model][contextTier]
| extend pricingApplies = coalesce(pricesLoaded and identityComplete and (isempty(tostring(pricing.projectResourceId)) or projectId =~ tostring(pricing.projectResourceId)) and provider in~ ('microsoft.foundry', 'azure.ai.foundry', 'azure.ai.openai', 'azure.ai.inference')
    and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
    and todouble(p.i) >= 0 and todouble(p.cr) >= 0 and todouble(p.cw) >= 0 and todouble(p.o) >= 0, false)
| extend priced = pricingApplies and usageValid,
    inputRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.i), real(null)), cacheReadRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.cr), real(null)),
    cacheWriteRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.cw), real(null)), outputRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.o), real(null))
| extend inputCost = iff(priced, (input - cached - written) * inputRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    cacheReadCost = iff(priced, cached * cacheReadRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    cacheWriteCost = iff(priced, written * cacheWriteRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    outputCost = iff(priced, output * outputRate / 1e6, real(null))
| extend estimated_cost = inputCost + cacheReadCost + cacheWriteCost + outputCost,
    cacheBenefit = iff(priced, (cached * (inputRate - cacheReadRate) - written * (cacheWriteRate - inputRate)) / 1e6, real(null)));
